kept.heading: TELLING AI TO ACT AS YOUR CUSTOMERS MAKES ITS ANSWER WORSE (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI-generated customer personas can overestimate purchase intent and mislead product or campaign decisions. In one test, AI predicted that 52% of shoppers would buy a product when only 33% did. In another, AI personas were less accurate at predicting headline clicks than a model asked directly to choose which headlines readers would click.

kept.heading: GOOGLE'S WHEN TO BUY GUIDE (8 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google's 2026 holiday shopping guide uses historical pricing data to identify when discounts peak across retail categories. Black Friday weekend offers the best selection and savings for electronics, shoes, fragrances, and appliances. Late December brings deeper discounts on cosmetics, handbags, and kitchenware. Search data also reveals last-minute shopping patterns. “Next day shipping” searches peak December 22, while “same day pickup” peaks December 24.

kept.heading: GATED CONTENT IS THE #1 ENEMY OF AI SEARCH (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Ungate content that helps buyers research categories and compare vendors to improve AI search visibility. Reserve forms for genuinely exclusive assets such as personalized ROI audits and proprietary data. For research reports, publish key findings and methodology on an accessible landing page while gating the full download. Noindex gated landing pages and hosted PDFs when appropriate to prevent them from competing with primary website content.

kept.heading: YOUR NEXT MARKETING HIRE SHOULD PROBABLY SURPRISE YOU (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: As AI makes content production cheaper and product comparisons easier, brands need to stand out during the awareness stage. Viral Producers test entertaining campaigns that get people talking about a brand. Internet Comedians create culturally relevant content people want to share. Creator Deal Makers build partnerships that help creators grow their audiences while expanding brand reach. These roles help brands earn attention rather than compete on content volume alone.

kept.heading: HOW TO AUTOMATE CONTENT CREATION: A FOLLOW-ALONG GUIDE (16 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Ahrefs built an AI workflow that updates 12 data-driven articles monthly by refreshing search data and rebuilding tables and charts in WordPress drafts. Its guide shows how to automate repetitive content tasks by documenting workflows and connecting reliable data sources. It recommends testing one workflow at a time and keeping human review before publication to catch errors and prevent broken automations from publishing inaccurate content.

kept.heading: HOW THE AI BOOM MIGHT REALLY END: 5 SCENARIOS (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: The AI boom may end not because demand disappears, but because profits shift away from major AI labs. Open-weight models are driving prices down while efficiency breakthroughs could reduce computing costs. AI companies risk failing to capture the value they create while chipmakers and infrastructure providers could still benefit from growing AI usage even if leading AI labs lose value.

kept.heading: WHAT ON EARTH IS GOING ON WITH AI PRICING AND PACKAGING? (8 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI companies are struggling to price products because usage costs vary widely and customers can't predict what credits or tokens will buy them. ChatGPT and Claude advertise vague usage limits, while Lovable sells credits without explaining what customers can build with them. Unlike traditional SaaS pricing based on seats or transactions, AI costs depend on the complexity of each task and the resources needed to complete it. Companies must make usage limits and costs easier to understand while managing unpredictable computing expenses and preventing abuse of free plans.
